blocks.text: KINGS OF THE EAST - Pres. Clinton's visit to China turning point in world history and fulfillment of prophecy! After receiving our technology and inventions it will return against us in the form of fiery missiles! "After some International crisis later the world will have a short false peace!" To sum it up we see the final phases in Rev.16:12-13. Right now China is building the world's largest dam! They know future weather conditions will cause a food shortage! "As you know the Scripts said that China would be stirring in the 90's and it's proven to be true!"

VITAL VIEWPOINT— Note: Also East Europe has united with West Europe working in World Trade! The 10 Kings are ready to join the beast! Western Europe will be joined directly to the antichrist as all nations unite. As predicted before hand, right now momentous changes are transforming the world. "Dynamic events are pulling the nations into an orbit of world government." As said, the 1990's are headed into year 2000, beginning of sorrows are starting. Then the door of millennium is not too far off. In the years ahead we will see the most unexpected events in 6000 years. "After the Tribulation the Lord Jesus will certainly rule!"

VATICAN PROPHECY - Scripts said it would be involved in events soon! Right after this was written murder took place right around the Pope. Some day the Vatican and Jerusalem will be ruled by a scarlet prince sitting in the Temple as a false messiah! — Scripts foretold of incidents in Washington D.C. — And at the Capital two policemen were murdered in a shoot out.

PROPHECY FULFILLING - Items in the News; July 1998 —The economy has gone global preparing for Word Trade! At this time there is recession in most of the world except for parts of Europe and the United States. (Note: Japan has been in its worst one since World War II) — The Scripts predicted what is yet ahead. — "After some more International crisis World Trade will come into its fullness!" — World Internet system already beginning to be involved in the markets! Trading out of the home through computers! The events are spectacular its hard to list the swiftness of the daily moments.

MAN OF DARK SENTENCES UNVEILED - A man of mystery is rising full of sorcery, witchcraft, magic, phantasm, glorified in a religious covering, illusion with a deceitful tongue of peace, promises of prosperity, global fulfillment and rest! But when finished he will be the man on the apocalyptic pale horse! (Rev. 6:8)

SUPER KNOWLEDGE - To increase in science, inventions and technology! Note: Men pride themselves in cloning animals and etc. —"But they still have to borrow a cell that God created!" Now they would like to do this process making a human. If they finally could duplicate one they would finally weaken down the human genes by copying, and sickness and unrealism would occur! "God is our great creator, satan is a imitator trying to build himself up through man!"

CONTINUING - Bio technology — science has already learned to make artificial body parts (hands, ears, legs and etc) Some are so egotistical they want to merge man with machine (electronics), in other words part man, part machine! This is called madness! "We know the anti-christ will reveal how to do many things that will occur over night." In fact in the next few years, science and technology as never seen before! A little after this civilization will meet it's downfall because of using science and technology in a negative way! "Also, inventions of war will be beyond comprehension in the next few years! Satan will use all of this to destroy most civilization, then God begins millennium! (Dan. 9:27 Rev. 20:2-3).
This was written years ago in advance! From Scroll # 113 -

THE CREATURE-LIKE SUPER COMPUTERS -— "Bible students are watching computers because they represent an integral aspect of the mechanical functions of anti-christ systems during the Great Tribulation period. They are sharply aware of the stark fact that anti-christ could never perform the predestined and prophesied tasks without the aids of the computer age. How, for instance, could he control the worldwide purchasing and selling of 44 billion plus humans on planet Earth without computer assistance? The job is formidable. Computers reduce the impossible to a relatively easy possibility." - Business Week Mag: "Artificial Intelligence — The Second Computer Age Begins!" "The world stands on the threshold of a second computer age. New technology now moving out of the laboratory is starting change the computer from a fantastically fast calculating machine to a device that mimics human thought processes — giving machines the capability to reason, make judgments and even learn. Already this artificial intelligence is performing tasks that were once thought to require human intelligence: diagnosing lung diseases, locating mineral deposits and deciding where to drill oil wells!" (Dan. 11:38-39, 43) — "Experts are convinced that it is now only a matter of time before these thinking computers open up awesome new applications in offices, factories and homes!" — "It will change civilization in a profound way...it will change the way we work, the way we learn and even the way we think about ourselves!" — "Computers act as intelligent assistants, furnish advice and make expert judgements, associated to Rev. 13:15, in specialized areas."
THE MASTER COMPUTER - Super Knowledge — "Steps are being actively taken to link up new, coded ID Credit Cards, for all U.S. military personnel, with a world-wide computer system."

Five Seconds To Chaos...Let's project the frightening possibilities...remembering that by 1990 the total population of the United States will only be about 248 million people! 1. It would mean that in ONE SECOND anti-christ could identify every person in the United States. 2. It would mean that in ONE more SEC- OND he could identify those who are Christians. 3. It would mean that in the third SECOND he could identify what street you live on. 4. It would mean that in the fourth SECOND he could identify how many are in your family. 5. It would mean that in the fifth SECOND he could program ALL the computers in your local supermarkets, departments stores and banks to indicate that you are forbidden to make any transactions.
